description: Track whether each finding is actually surfaced or used (effectiveness-ledger style), allowing proven findings to persist while never-surfaced findings decay out automatically.

requirements.description: [PLANNED/DEFERRED] Track each time a finding is surfaced in a query result or cited in a synthesis (effectiveness events). Maintain an effectiveness ledger per finding. Findings with non-zero effectiveness resist decay; findings with zero effectiveness over a configurable period decay out automatically (confidence reduced to below pruning threshold and flagged for GC). This ensures actively useful findings persist while never-surfaced findings are organically removed.
requirements.title: Usage-Telemetry-Driven Finding Effectiveness Ledger and Auto-Decay

validation.notes: Effectiveness ledger increments the surfaced_count for a finding when it appears in a query result
Effectiveness ledger increments the cited_count for a finding when it is cited in an L1/L2 synthesis
Auto-decay function reduces confidence below pruning threshold after configurable zero-surfacing period
A finding with surfaced_count > 0 in the last decay window is not auto-decayed
Issue a query that surfaces a finding; verify effectiveness ledger entry is updated; verify finding confidence is not reduced at next decay run
Let a finding go unsurfaced for the configured decay period; run the decay job; verify confidence has been reduced
The findings store self-curates over time, retaining proven findings and removing stale ones without manual intervention

title: Usage-Telemetry-Driven Curation
